note: Working 46-acre farm 2 min off I-95 near Lumberton; transient RV sites among horse and cow pastures (general RV, not equestrian). --Claude
summary: Priced and confirmed on the operator's own Hipcamp listing (claimed, bookable, reviews from Sept 2026): $42/night full hookups, water/sewer at every site, 26 RV sites (12 sold on Hipcamp, rigs under 60 ft), bathhouse with shower and flush toilet, free WiFi, no on-site laundry, reservable same day to 6 months ahead. Not stated: electric amperage, season (reviews show it open in September 2026). Note trimmed of the site count, WiFi and bathhouse the fields now hold.
flags: Website is Facebook only; the operator books through its Hipcamp listing https://www.hipcamp.com/en-US/land/north-carolina-double-l-farms-rv-park-llc-y0zhze1l (put that, or keep Facebook beside it). Presence also passes on Google Maps: 4.8 stars from 83 reviews, phone (910) 258-2621 (matches).

Long-stay check: the park is co-located with a mobile-home community (Campendium names it 'Double L Farms Mobile Home Community & RV Park'), but the RV sites are sold nightly on Hipcamp (12 of 26), so tests 2 and 4 pass.
